decision_conditions: The works approved by this Listed Building Consent must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this decision notice. Reason: To comply with S.51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice.Location Plan - GH/W-SLP—01 Rev. ALocation Plan - PP-14522809v1Block Plan - GH/W-BP—01 Rev. BExisting Ground Floor Plan (Window Numbers)Window Repair Schedule - GHWT-WG/48Window Repair Schedule - GHWT-WG/56Window Repair Schedule - GHWT-WG/59Window Repair Schedule - GHWT-WG/60Window Repair Schedule - GHWT-WG/64Window Repair Schedule - GHWT-WG/65Window Restrictors and Brush Seal Details - GHWT/RBS—01Example of B&R Resin Window Repair - GH/W-EX—01Schedule of RepairsSchedule of Works Rev. BCovering LetterHeritage StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To ensure a design which complies with Development Plan Policies and to preserve the existing heritage asset.

The Local Planning Authority shall be notified of any loss or damage within one working day and any necessary remedial works will be agreed in writing (or necessary approvals granted) and subsequently implemented.Reason: To preserve the character of the existing heritage asset.
